heading: Recommended combinations
text:
## Recommended combinations [LCAP.6]

| Goal | Dialect | Overrides |
|---|---|---|
| Stream processing, no special constraints | `default` | — |
| Hard RT, logical derived facts allowed | `realtime` | — |
| Hard RT, tightest T_wcet, joins O(1) | `realtime` | `linear_scan: false` |
| Hard RT, no derived facts, smallest footprint | `realtime` | `logical: false` |
| Tightest possible — alpha-only, hard RT | `realtime` | `linear_scan: false`, `logical: false` |
| Bounded memory, no hard deadline (embedded baseline) | `default` | `constspace: true` |
| Bounded memory + O(1) ops, no deadline | `default` | `constspace: true`, `linear_scan: false` |
| Non-RT, O(1) joins at any scale | `default` | `linear_scan: false` |
| Non-RT, no TMS overhead | `default` | `logical: false` |
| Per-emit TTL with hard RT | `realtime` | `dynamic_ttl: true` |
| Per-emit TTL, non-RT | `default` | `dynamic_ttl: true` |

The rows that use the `realtime` dialect or set `constspace: true` are
deferred with those capabilities, and the compiler refuses them in this
edition ([LCAP.2.1.5]).

**The most common RT deployment** is the `realtime` dialect with
`linear_scan: false`: hard RT with O(1) joins, bounded strings, fixed
T_wcet, and logical facts still available for derived-state patterns.

**The minimum footprint deployment** adds `logical: false`: alpha-only
mode, no TMS, no beta network, and T_wcet is a single constant number.
Appropriate for high-frequency single-fact pattern detection with no
cross-schema correlation.
